title: Front door leaf, 0.8 m by 2.0 m
description: A plain front door leaf, 0.8 m wide, 2.0 m high and 4 cm thick, with a lever handle on both faces near the edge away from the hinge, 1.0 m above the bottom. It hangs in the door module by a hinge along its left edge, seen from outside.

reference_pack.value_or_path: Typical sizes for a two-storey Tokyo house, chosen for this test. Not measured from a real building, so record dimension_source as "estimated".
Use only library materials from assets/mat/. Give each glTF material the library ID as its name and the values in that material.json. No custom materials and no textures in this test.

The leaf fills a box from x = 0 to 0.8, y = 0 to 2.0 and z = -0.02 to 0.02. Its origin is on the hinge line, at the bottom. The outer face faces +Z. The handles are the only parts outside the box. Each handle stands exactly 6 cm proud of its face, one on each face, which is what makes the task's depth 0.16 m (0.04 m of leaf plus 0.06 m on each side). The validator measures the depth with the handles on.
See connector_frames in this task. Each gives a connector's position and the directions of its +Z and +Y, in the asset's own axes (+X right, +Y up, +Z front). The validator checks them.
